title: Hoshino Ichika — For The Perfect Sound〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I thought it was you, Ichika. I didn't realize you were here. What you were playing just now sounded so nice.
bgm_area00001

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Remember the story Shiho told us yesterday after practice, about what happened when she was in elementary school?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
After hearing that, I felt...
I felt that I needed to keep doing better.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I mean, it's like the root of who she is...
It feels like I learned the reason why she decided to start playing the bass and practiced so much.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I see.
Sounds like her story had a positive effect on you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It did. After I got home yesterday, I picked up my guitar and kept playing it until I went to bed.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. That definitely seems like something you'd do, Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Also, I think this was a very big step for Leo/need.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Me too. I feel that we're getting a much better idea of what we want our music to be about now.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Is something wrong...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, um... I've been thinking a lot lately about what's gonna happen to us moving forward...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Now that we're pros, we can't really just keep doing what we want...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm a little worried about what the future has in store for us... Thinking about it makes me a bit anxious.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Anxious...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I think you're more excited than anxious, Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I mean, that's what I felt from the way you were playing just now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What I heard was, “I'm looking forward to seeing what kinds of songs and performances we're going to create and put on.”

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, really...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. So, I think you'll do just fine if you stay on this course.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
With Shiho, Honami and Saki.
Just keep putting on great performances like you always have.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thanks, Miku.
Hearing you say that makes me feel more brave.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, I'm going to do my best during today's practice too!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Good. And you'll always have my support, Ichika!
